final:
type Channel = { cap: int, items: List[int] }

chan_new(cap: int) -> Channel =
  pre cap >= 0
  post out.cap == cap
  ex chan_new(3).cap == 3
  Channel(cap: cap, items: [])

send(ch: Channel, v: int) -> Channel? =
  pre ch.items.len() <= ch.cap
  post out == None or ch.items.len() < ch.cap
  ex send(chan_new(0), 1) == None
  if ch.items.len() >= ch.cap
    return None
  let items = ch.items + [v]
  Channel(cap: ch.cap, items: items)

accepted(cap: int, xs: List[int]) -> int uses nondet =
  pre cap >= 0
  post out >= 0 and out <= cap and out <= xs.len()
  ex accepted(0, [1, 2, 3]) == 0
  ex accepted(5, []) == 0
  var ch = chan_new(cap)
  var n = 0
  for x in xs
    let next = send(ch, x) else break
    ch = next
    n += 1
  n
